### Summary

The change adds on-demand Playwright proof scenarios under `verify/`, a `recordVideoDir` option on the e2e launch helper, and a verify skill doc. It touches no Electron boundary, no shared imports, no install scripts and no CI, and the ADR 0006 and 0027 references exist. I found one weak test (the library scenario never asserts the seeded recording is listed) and two smaller robustness points.
